hooks.command: jq -c '(.tool_input.branch // "" | ascii_downcase) as $b | (.tool_input.repo // "" | ascii_downcase) as $r | if $b == "main" and $r == "trust-graph" then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Direct writes to main are blocked in this repo.
